tools.name: search_festivals
tools.description: Search festivals in South Korea from the Festival Times (페스티벌타임즈) festival database. Returns festivals running at any point between `from` and `to` (default: today to 30 days later), with name, dates, region, venue, a short summary and the canonical festivaltimes.net URL. Data is in Korean. Always c

tools.name: festivals_this_weekend
tools.description: List festivals in South Korea running this coming weekend (Saturday-Sunday, Asia/Seoul; on a Sunday, just today), optionally limited to a region. Use for questions like "이번 주말 경기도 축제". Each result carries its festivaltimes.net URL; cite it.

tools.name: get_festival
tools.description: Full public details of one festival: dates, venue, address, organizer, host, fees, phone, official homepage, description and related Festival Times articles. Pass the slug or URL returned by search_festivals (or the festival id).

tools.name: search_concerts
tools.description: Search popular-music concerts in South Korea (KOPIS data as published on the Festival Times English edition). Filter by keyword (title, performer, venue), region and dates (default: today to 30 days later). Returns Korean titles with dates, venue, performers, price and the festivaltimes.net URL.

tools.name: latest_news
tools.description: Latest published articles from Festival Times (페스티벌타임즈), a Korean newspaper covering festivals. Optional category by slug or Korean name, e.g. "festival-news" (축제뉴스), "guide" (축제가이드), "industry" (축제산업), "culture" (공연/전시), "expo" (박람회), "world" (해외축제). Returns title, date, summary and URL.

tools.name: search_articles
tools.description: Search published Festival Times articles by keyword in the title or summary (Korean keywords work best, e.g. a festival or town name). Returns newest first with title, date, summary and URL.
